title: Saint Rose of Lima, Virgin
short_summary: Saint Rose of Lima is honored in the Dominican calendar as a virgin whose prayer, penance, charity, and witness to Christ took root in Lima and continue to speak to the Church in the Americas.
key_facts: The Dominican Calendarium lists Saint Rose of Lima on August 23.
The Order of Preachers identifies her as a virgin.
The Order's saints and blesseds page says Isabel Flores, known as Rose, was born in Lima.
Her profile is presented as a Dominican proper observance, not as a universal replacement for the day.
In 2026, August 23 falls on a Sunday, so the app keeps the general U.S. calendar day primary.

sections.heading: Holiness in Lima
sections.body: Rose's life is remembered for prayer, penance, and charity. Her witness shows that the call to holiness takes root in particular places and cultures while remaining centered on Christ.

sections.heading: Prayer and penance
sections.body: The app presents her penitential witness carefully, not as spectacle, but as a sign of a heart given to Christ and to intercession.

sections.heading: Charity close to home
sections.body: Rose's holiness was not abstract. Her memory invites attention to concrete charity, especially toward those near enough to be served with patience.

sections.heading: A Sunday occurrence in 2026
sections.body: Because this observance falls on a Sunday in 2026, the app presents it as Dominican local information and does not replace the primary liturgical day.

catholic_connection_sections.heading: Consecrated love
catholic_connection_sections.body: Rose's witness points to a life given to Christ through prayer and sacrificial charity.

catholic_connection_sections.heading: Holiness in the Americas
catholic_connection_sections.body: Her memory helps the faithful see that sanctity is not distant from local history, culture, family, and daily acts of love.
